metaDescription: Need cooling sport towels fast? Rush production available. Order custom cooling towels with quick turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When your event or promotion is just days away, standard lead times won't cut it. That's why Perfect Imprints offers rush production on custom cooling sport towels — with turnaround as fast as 1–5 business days after artwork approval. Whether you need branded rally towels for an upcoming trade show or cooling towels for a last-minute employee appreciation event, our rush service ensures you get high-quality, decorated towels in time. Lead times depend on your artwork and decoration method, so contact us to confirm your deadline.
